sourceEvidence.defectOrigin: Isolated during #312 R30 dual-role admission closeout planning (Owner direction: kaicreator-mm/tally#392 comment 6881140176, 2026-11-14). The real T06d/T06j Host admission path cannot accept the two distinct role Claims required by #312.

defects.defect: readNativeHostClaimPreflightFromClient requires claimEvents.reason==='NO_DISPATCH_CLAIM_EVENTS' and candidateCount===0. After one lawful role Claim is published on the Issue, every further role Claim fails NATIVE_CLAIM_ABSENCE_UNQUALIFIED. The behavior is pinned by the existing negative test 'even shape-valid self-reported DISPATCH_CLAIMED denies clean preflight' in task-claim-host-preflight.test.mjs (blob e68a22aca09c1667f408d53ec108805dce492251).

createHostAdmissionSourceFromClient.registrySnapshot classification counts every registry row whose protectedClaimKey differs from the request key as incompatible (activeIncompatibleClaimCount). The intentionally compatible builder-versus-reviewer roles of the same Task/source therefore deny INCOMPATIBLE_OR_PENDING_CLAIM_EXISTS, and the controller contract (single-writer.mjs validPreflight requires activeIncompatibleClaimCount===0) makes the second role unadmittable.

sourceEvidence.boundary: This is a fail-closed admission defect: the gate rejects a lawful second role. It is NOT permission to bypass preflight, seed CAS, reuse a historical Claim, publish a replacement Claim on an already-claimed protected key, or split the selected Host registry into disconnected per-role registries.

roleCompatibilityModel.identity: Process independence between the two roles requires distinct operatorId AND distinct writerId under the selected Host. The GitHub transport login may be identical; a different login alone is not independence proof.
roleCompatibilityModel.canonicalKeys: Each role claim binds protectedClaimKey <repository>#<issueNumber>:<actorRole>:__default__ with admission_generation 1. Same Task + different role = different key = potentially compatible. Same Task + same role = same key = duplicate, never admittable.
roleCompatibilityModel.sameRegistry: Both roles are admitted against ONE exact current registry/Pack/FSW binding of the selected Host. Splitting roles into disconnected registries is prohibited.

preflight.input: Add optional actorRole (builder|reviewer|validator). Invalid value fails INVALID_NATIVE_PREFLIGHT_REQUEST.
preflight.pairReadUnchanged: readNativeTaskSourcePairFromClient continues to qualify Issue currentness, WorkItem source-qualification and pair drift; its claimEvents acceptance widens only within the two pair-qualified reasons (NO_DISPATCH_CLAIM_EVENTS, CLAIM_EVENT_CANDIDATES_NOT_CAS_ATTESTED) with consistent counts.
preflight.roleBearingCandidates: Candidates are re-observed through the existing readClaimEventCandidatesFromClient entry (imported, not modified). Its own fail-closed behavior (duplicate dispatch, cross-task/stale, edited identity, malformed canonical comment, scan limit, mid-read drift) propagates as BLOCKED with the reader reason.
preflight.zeroCandidates: Zero candidates yields NATIVE_SOURCE_PREFLIGHT_READY exactly as today: fresh-Task behavior unchanged.
preflight.candidatesPresentUndeclaredRole: Candidates present without a declared request actorRole stays BLOCKED with NATIVE_CLAIM_ABSENCE_UNQUALIFIED (legacy fail-closed path preserved).
candidatesPresentDeclaredRole: Each candidate must carry a valid actor_role in builder|reviewer|validator, protected_claim_key exactly <repository>#<issueNumber>:<candidate.actorRole>:__default__, and admission_generation === 1; otherwise BLOCKED NATIVE_CLAIM_ROLE_CANDIDATE_UNQUALIFIED.
A candidate whose actor_role equals the requested role, or two candidates sharing one protectedClaimKey, is a claim overwrite attempt: BLOCKED NATIVE_CLAIM_ROLE_DUPLICATE_CANDIDATE.

Otherwise NATIVE_SOURCE_PREFLIGHT_READY with a bounded role-bearing candidate projection (commentId, commentRef, dispatchId, actorRole, operatorId, protectedClaimKey, claimGeneration, sourceSha, transportActor, sourceClass). Everything stays claimAccepted:false, claimStatus NOT_VERIFIED, advisory; dispatchSourceBound/publisherSourceBound stay false and no permit boolean is added.

compatibleRowAllOf: row.issueRef === request.issueRef and row.repository === request.repository and row.sourceSha === request.sourceSha and row.generation === 1 (same Task/source/generation binding)
row.phase === 'PUBLISHED_VERIFIED' (a PENDING row of any role blocks admission; lost ACK reconciles by readback, never blind POST)

hostAdmission.incompatibleRows: Every row failing any compatible clause is incompatible. activeIncompatibleClaimCount counts incompatible rows only; count>0 denies INCOMPATIBLE_OR_PENDING_CLAIM_EXISTS with the count (exact reason preserved). complete:true still requires count===0, so single-writer.mjs validPreflight is satisfied without any controller edit.
hostAdmission.candidateWithoutRow: Any candidate projection without a matching compatible registry row denies CLAIM_CANDIDATE_WITHOUT_VERIFIED_CAS_ROW: a native claim observed outside this Host's durable CAS is divergent or forged.
